description: Flew for North Central Airlines as passenger and cargo aircraft 1953 to 1968; acquired by the Aviation Heritage Center July 2016 and painted in North Central colours; live FAA registry shows AHCW NORTH CENTRAL DC-3 LLC of Sheboygan Falls with a valid certificate to 30 April 2028 which is the strongest currency evidence in this state; FAA lists model DC3-G202A and gives no MFR year so year_built is left blank

T-33A-1-LO; SOC 8 Nov 1962 at Tyndall AFB; civil life as N11987 with Lewis University then a chain of private owners; registration cancelled as destroyed 2 May 2007; Baugher records it with the Aviation Heritage Center of Wisconsin Sheboygan by July 2012 mounted in front of the airport

Ex-Philippine Air Force airframe used to train Hmong pilots at Udorn RTAFB Thailand under Operation Waterpump; restored to exhibition quality by EAA Chapter 766 and displayed as the centrepiece of the museum's US Secret War in Laos exhibit; former US civil registration N2065F is now deregistered; variant left blank because Wikipedia says T-28B while Aerial Visuals says T-28B with a T-28A construction number and the museum itself says only T-28
